entities.summary: Regina Daniels is a Nigerian actress and film producer. As a child actor, she starred as Onyeure in the drama film Dumebi in School (2014), Kenya Obi in Merry Men 2 (2019), and Yewande in the action film Hakeem: Seeking Justice (2025).
